# elizaos/eliza Daily Update (Aug 5, 2026)

## OVERVIEW 
Development on August 5, 2026, focused on enhancing AI agent reliability, cloud infrastructure stability, and voice capabilities. Key achievements include the integration of Fish Audio streaming TTS, significant improvements to turn-delivery observability, and critical fixes for reasoning model tool-call budgets. Infrastructure efforts centered on node embedding sidecars and CI/CD workflow restoration.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

**Voice and Streaming Capabilities**
*   Integrated Fish Audio streaming TTS plugin to expand voice-pipeline capabilities ([#17709](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17709)).
*   Improved voice cold-start reliability by ensuring caches are warmed for realtime turns ([#17744](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17744)).
*   Resolved integration gaps between cloud voice and pendant systems ([#17743](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17743)).

**Agent Runtime and Observability**
*   Enhanced turn-delivery observability and sub-agent verification, ensuring deliberate silence is recorded as a terminal state ([#17631](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17631)).
*   Optimized chat planner budgets for reasoning models to prevent tool-call starvation and improved stream-start retries ([#17630](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17630)).
*   Hardened security by preventing the echoing of external-content security envelopes into chat ([#17629](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17629)).
*   Improved ambient turn hygiene by implementing policy-gated silence and machine-shaped task history ([#17628](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17628)).
*   Ensured scheduled prompt-automations deliver output rather than bare acknowledgements ([#17776](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17776)).

**Cloud Infrastructure and CI/CD**
*   Provisioned and self-healed node embedding sidecars to support production agent nodes ([#17787](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17787)).
*   Restored certification workflows and scripts (`scripts/vast`) following previous build artifact cleanup ([#17792](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17792), [#17790](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17790)).
*   Fixed gateway issues to ensure messages are processed for users whose agents are still provisioning ([#17744](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17744)).
*   Addressed inference billing issues by republishing org-balance gate hints after debits ([#17745](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17745)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
A wide range of PRs were opened, focusing on:
*   **Cloud Stability:** [#17795](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17795) (memory capping), [#17788](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17788) (SSO bridge), [#17781](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17781), [#17772](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17772), [#17770](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17770) (ledger/billing), and [#17764](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17764) (onboarding).
*   **UI/UX:** [#17793](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17793), [#17784](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17784) (capacitor stubs), and [#17786](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17786) (homepage).
*   **Core/Plugins:** [#17777](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17777) (trajectories), [#17775](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17775), [#17773](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17773) (wallet security), and [#17734](https://github.com/elizaos/eliza/pull/17734) (Cheshire Terminal plugins).
